ir.name: builder_all_pairs_tieclamp_001
ir.intuition: All-pairs pairing with an explicit tie-zone constraint: filter out near-equal objectives (ties) and clamp objectives to avoid NaN/inf-driven invalid comparisons, preserving pairwise PrefBatch output.
ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']

    hp = extra.get('hyperparams', {})
    # tie_eps filters out near-ties where supervision is ambiguous.
    tie_eps = float(extra.get('tie_eps', hp.get('tie_eps', 0.0)))
    # obj_clip prevents inf/nan propagation in comparisons.
    obj_clip = float(extra.get('obj_clip', hp.get('obj_clip', 1e6)))

    obj = ops.clamp(objective, -obj_clip, obj_clip)

    # Prefer lower objective values; create all winner/loser pairs.
    diff = obj[:, :, None] - obj[:, None, :]
    strict = diff < 0

    # Explicit constraint: remove tie/near-tie zone.
    if tie_eps > 0.0:
        strict = strict & (ops.abs(diff) > tie_eps)

    b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx = strict.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'all_pairs_tieclamp', 'tie_eps': tie_eps, 'obj_clip': obj_clip})
